import sys, re

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read()
    if not data:
        return
    # Extract numbers (int or float, possibly with sign)
    tokens = re.findall(r'[-+]?\d*\.\d+|[-+]?\d+', data)
    if len(tokens) < 3:
        return
    principal = float(tokens[0])
    rate = float(tokens[1])
    time = int(float(tokens[2]))  # time may be given as float, convert to int
    interest = principal * rate / 100.0 * (time / 12.0)
    # Print result preserving decimal point
    print(interest)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
